about: What cfunc-m0.1 ported into crates/calc-value from the pinned legacy source, what it changed and why, what it left out with the beads that will need it (found by the owner search it records), and each OxFunc test whose expectation the port keeps, changes or drops. Only this bead writes this file.

sources.pin: migration/source-manifest.json (pin date 2026-10-15); the blob equals the pin's

lookup.how_the_port_meets_it: The file's only run-time loads are fs::read_dir and fs::read_to_string in its test module wire_schema_tests, which reads the repository's own sources. That module is not ported, and nothing ported loads anything at run time, so no listed module needs a clean replacement.

kept: a value is a worksheet-visible CoreValue plus an optional shared callable
constructors new, number, text, logical, error, empty, missing, array, reference, callable
projections core, as_number, as_text, as_logical, as_error, as_array, as_reference, is_empty, is_missing, callable_value
a callable value's core is Error(Calc) (#CALC!), so as_error reports Calc
equality compares the core and the callable

changes.change: The rich slot Option<Shared<RichValue>> becomes callable: Option<Arc<CallableValue>>.
changes.reason: Of the four rich kinds only the callable is in this bead (scalar/array/error/reference/callable values); object, presentation and error-metadata rich values are not ported (see not_ported). One Arc pointer keeps the slot one pointer wide, as it was.

changes.change: The fields are private; a value is built only through its constructors.
changes.reason: Keeps the callable invariant (a callable's core is #CALC!) true by construction.
They serve ValueTag and ValueBoundary, which are not ported.

kept: the eight variants Number(f64), Text, Logical(bool), Error(WorksheetErrorCode), Empty, Missing, Array, Reference, in that order
Empty (an empty cell) and Missing (an omitted argument) stay distinct

changes.change: Reference carries the typed ReferenceLike below instead of a string-address reference.
Text and Array payloads are Arc-owned (ExcelText over Arc<[u16]>, CalcArray over Arc<[CalcValue]>).
changes.reason: The bead asks for Arc-owned immutable payloads: a clone shares its payload, which cfunc_m0_1__send_sync observes by pointer identity.

kept: the fourteen codes Null, Div0, Value, Ref, Name, Num, NA, Busy, GettingData, Spill, Calc, Field, Blocked, Connect, in that order

changes.change: Derives Hash, and gains WorksheetErrorCode::all(), the fourteen codes in declaration order (implemented fresh).
changes.reason: all() is the non-test function that names each variant (seams.json), and gives the acceptance case an observable that there are exactly fourteen distinct codes.

kept: a reference value can hold several areas (multi-area) and reports area_count
the members of a union keep their order, duplicates included

changes.change: The target text, the textual identity (ReferenceKind plus ExcelText), the display text, the reference system id, the opaque handle identity and the composite identity are replaced by one or more typed GridAreas of one sheet, each a SheetId and checked 1-based coordinates. Constructors cell, area and from_areas; accessors areas, area_count and sheet.
changes.reason: The bead replaces string-address payloads with typed references built from SheetId and checked coordinates. Reference text (A1, R1C1, structured, 3D, spill anchors) is parsed and bound by CalcFml, which produces these areas.

changes.change: multi_area, multi_area_targets and normalized (trimming the target text and splitting it at top-level commas) are removed.
changes.reason: There is no text to split or trim; from_areas takes the areas themselves. One area given to from_areas equals ReferenceLike::area of it, so equality is structural.

changes.change: A multi-area reference shares its areas behind Arc<[GridArea]>; a single area is held inline and allocates nothing.
changes.reason: Arc-owned immutable payloads without an allocation for the single-area case.

changes.change: Duplicates in a union are kept.
changes.reason: OxFunc's multi_area kept every part as given; the port keeps that.

changes.change: ReferenceKind (A1, Area, MultiArea, ThreeD, Structured, SpillAnchor) and kind() are dropped: a reference is its typed areas.
changes.reason: The kind classified reference text, which the bead removes. A cell, an area and a multi-area reference are told apart by their areas (area_count, GridArea::cell_count); ThreeD, Structured and SpillAnchor name reference forms that are not representable in this bead (see not_ported, with their beads).

changes.change: A multi-area (union) reference holds areas of one sheet only. from_areas returns Result: areas on more than one sheet are refused with ReferenceError::SheetMismatch, and no areas with ReferenceError::NoAreas. OxFunc's multi_area took any target texts, so a union could name parts of different sheets, and it returned None for fewer than two parts, where from_areas gives the single-area reference for one area.
changes.reason: The orchestrator's round-1 ruling: Excel's union operator works within one sheet, so a multi-area reference holds areas of one sheet only, with a typed error otherwise. Witnessed by calc-value value::tests::a_union_reference_holds_areas_of_one_sheet_only and by cfunc_m0_1__grid_edges (two live sheets, and a released and reissued slot).

changes.change: area_count for a 3D reference: OxFunc counted 1 for every reference whose kind was not MultiArea, a ThreeD reference over any number of sheets included (area_count is the number of parts of a MultiArea target, else 1). calc-value has no 3D reference, and a 3D span cannot be built as a union of per-sheet areas because a union holds one sheet, so area_count is defined only for references of one sheet.
changes.reason: 3D sheet spans are bound by cfml-m3.2, which decides their representation and count when it adds them; this bead does not carry OxFunc's count of 1 forward for a form it cannot represent. No test in the ported file checks a ThreeD area_count.

kept: values are shared through Arc (the send-values arm of the alias)

changes.change: The Shared<T> alias, the send-values cargo feature and its Rc arm are removed. calc-value declares no cargo features; OpaqueCallable always requires Send + Sync.
changes.reason: The bead removes the Rc feature arm: Arc is the only shared pointer, so there is no thread-bound variant. cfunc_m0_1__send_sync reads calc-value's Cargo.toml and every source file its root declares (through include_str!, so the check also runs in the browsers) and fails on a [features] table, a table outside its allowed set, a root key (one before the first table header), an optional dependency, a build key, a thread-bound pointer or cell (std::rc, Rc, RefCell, Cell and their kin) and any cfg other than the unit tests' own.

kept: text is UTF-16 code units, not necessarily valid UTF-16
from_interop_assignment truncates to 32,767 code units and can leave a dangling high surrogate
from_utf16_code_units does not truncate
len_utf16_code_units, utf16_code_units, to_string_lossy, has_dangling_high_surrogate_tail

changes.change: The code units are held in Arc<[u16]> instead of Vec<u16>; from_interop_assignment stops encoding at the limit instead of encoding everything and truncating.
changes.reason: Arc-owned immutable payload; the resulting code units are the same.

kept: non-empty rectangular arrays in row-major order
new rejects a zero dimension or a cell count that does not match the shape
from_rows rejects no rows, an empty row or ragged rows
get, row_slice and iter_row_major index in row-major order; get and row_slice return None outside the shape
arrays may hold nested arrays and Missing elements

changes.change: ArrayShape::cell_count returns Option<usize> (None when rows * cols overflows) instead of an unchecked product.
changes.reason: The unchecked product could overflow, most easily on wasm32's 32-bit usize; new() compares against the checked count.

changes.change: The cells are held in Arc<[CalcValue]>.
from_scalar returns the array instead of Option (it never failed); from_cells_iter is removed (new takes the cells).
changes.reason: Interface simplification with no semantic difference.

ported.symbol: CallableArityShape, OpaqueCallable and CallableValue (the callable of CalcValue::callable)
kept: CallableArityShape {min, max} with exact, range and accepts, unchanged
OpaqueCallable: Debug + Send + Sync + 'static with as_any, the identity the value model never inspects
two callable values are equal when their arities are equal and they share one handle (Arc::ptr_eq); the summary is not compared

changes.change: CallableValue's fields are private (constructor new(arity, summary, handle); accessors arity, summary, handle) and the summary is Arc<str>.
changes.reason: Arc-owned immutable payloads; Send + Sync is the trait's own bound, not a feature.

limits: ID uniqueness holds among the IDs one allocator issues. Two allocators can issue equal IDs, and an allocator cannot tell an ID another allocator of the same kind issued from its own; identity across workbooks is the pair of WorkbookId and the ID inside that workbook.

An allocator addresses slot indices below u32::MAX and past that refuses with IdError::Exhausted. The retirement and exhaustion paths are covered by calc-value unit tests that set a slot's generation or the slot limit directly, not by the acceptance cases.
NumericTargetId keeps its four parts as text; it does not parse an Excel build number or check a channel name.

wasm32-unknown-unknown has no threads: cfunc_m0_1__send_sync spawns and joins a thread natively only; in Chrome and Firefox the Send + Sync bound rests on the compile-time assertions.

The no-opt-out check of cfunc_m0_1__send_sync reads text, not the compiler's view: it reads comments and strings as code (so calc-value's sources do not use the banned words anywhere), it finds the module files through the root's mod declarations (an include macro or a #[path] attribute fails the case, and a file no module declares is not compiled), and it cannot read a build script the manifest does not name; a cfg such a script set would still need a cfg in the sources, which the check fails.
